note: Gabon, read on 2026-10-30 in the Spanish Embassy in Libreville's page on working in Gabon (exteriores.gob.es, undated; a secondary source, which sends the reader to the Direction Générale de la Documentation et de l'Immigration, www.dgdi.ga, 'permis de residence' section; that site didn't answer today). Entry needs a visa, which allows a stay of three months; the residence permit must be applied for two months before that visa expires, with a request to the Governor of the Estuaire province, the passport with its entry visa, a certificate of employment, proof of housing and a legalised lease, a photograph and the family book, and a deposit (fianza) of 900,000 F CFA for a first permit and 150,000 F CFA for later renewals. The deposit is a bond, not the permit's fee, so no fee is written; the mention of renewals makes it renewable. That the request starts before the entry visa runs out suggests it is made in Gabon, but the page doesn't say where it is lodged, so `apply` is left out. The page names the permit in Spanish (permiso de residencia); the name written is the DGDI's section's French. Although a certificate of employment is among the documents, the page presents the permit as the one every foreigner staying beyond the visa needs, so it is written as a card for any purpose (`general`). The work permit, a separate paper, is valid for one worker, one job and one firm, for at most two years, renewable, applied for by the employer, and an initial one can't, save in special cases, go to a worker living abroad; it isn't a residence route and the form doesn't hold it. The page gives no term or decision time for the residence permit, nor anything on permanent residence or naturalisation.

sources.title: Embajada de España en Libreville, Trabajar (Tipos de permisos de residencia y de trabajo)
sources.said: Este visado autoriza la permanencia en Gabón durante 3 meses. ... -sección "permis de residence"). ... La tramitación del permiso de residencia se debe de iniciar 2 meses antes de la expiración del visado inicial de 3 meses. ... Carta de solicitud de la tarjeta de residencia dirigida al Gobernador de la provincia de “L'Estuaire” ... Certificado de empleo ... Fianza de 900.000 Fcfa para la primera solicitud del permiso de residencia ... Fianza de 150.000 Fcfa para ulteriores renovaciones. ... El permiso de trabajo es válido sólo para un trabajador, un empleo y una empresa determinados. Su duración no puede exceder dos años. Es renovable.
